business_problem: New Computer needed to improve Dot’s long-term memory retrieval so the assistant could answer personalized queries accurately across diverse intents without exposing private user data during experimentation.
solution_summary: New Computer designed Dot around an agentic memory system where memories are created or pre-calculated first and only retrieved later, which makes retrieval quality a core product problem rather than a back-end detail. To tune that system safely, the team created cohorts of synthetic users with LLM-generated backstories, seeded their memory databases from initial conversations, and stored queries plus the full set of candidate memories in LangSmith datasets. Retrieval experiments compared simple semantic baselines against keyword, BM25, and meta-field-filtered methods using labeled examples and metrics for precision, recall, and F1. The same workflow was then extended to Dot’s dynamic conversational prompt, where LangSmith comparison views made prompt regressions visible and the built-in playground let the team adjust prompts without leaving the tool. This turned privacy-preserving retrieval tuning into a repeatable experimental loop.

solution_components.name: Dot
solution_components.role: Uses the retrieved memories and dynamic prompts to provide personalized assistance to end users.

solution_components.name: LangSmith
solution_components.role: Stores datasets, runs experiments, and exposes comparison views for retrieval and prompt tuning.

data_flow: Synthetic-user conversations seed memory databases, user-style queries and the available memories are stored in LangSmith datasets, multiple retrieval methods are evaluated against labeled relevance sets, and the best memories are fed back into Dot’s dynamic conversational prompt for personalized responses.
business_outcome: New Computer improved retrieval quality for Dot, sped prompt iteration on highly variable conversational behavior, and converted a new wave of users more effectively by making the personal-AI experience feel more accurate and bespoke over time.
metrics: more than 45% of which converted to the app’s paid tier
